scientific_integrity: All universal claims rest on explicit analytic proofs; the accompanying finite numerical checks are only regression/consistency diagnostics.
scientific_limitations: Fixed planar regular polygons, Haar-uniform orientation and deterministic angular shifts only. No arbitrary-convex-body claim, no minimum over rectangle orientations, and no correlation in the exactly circular limit, where width variance vanishes. Priority is assessed by available literature and published research-record comparison, not independently certified.
title: Orthogonal-width copulas and a universal angular covariance transition for regular polygons
